option_relations.rationale: SARS-CoV-2–associated optic neuritis is a specific type of optic neuritis that can be associated with COVID-19, which is related to COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis
Immune-mediated parainfectious optic neuritis is a broader category that is not specifically related to COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis
COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis is a direct match for the leaf label
Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis is a broader category that encompasses COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis
